column10: Bubble tea – also known as boba tea, pearl milk tea, or tapioca milk tea – is a drink that was invented about 40 years ago by two tearooms in Taiwan. Bubble tea contains chewy tapioca pearls called “boba”. The classic flavor has three main ingredients – black tea, milk, and boba – but the term “bubble tea” can refer to any drink that has boba inside, including milk teas, fruit teas, and even slushies, all of which often include one or more flavor syrups. There are also different kinds of boba, like chewy boba made with honey, or fruity boba filled with juice that pops when you bite into it. Some people add extra toppings to their bubble tea, like grass jelly, coconut jelly, aloe vera, red bean, or cheese foam. When you order bubble tea, you can usually ask for it to be made hot or cold, and you can change how much ice or sugar you want in your drink too. You also get a straw that is specially made to be wide enough for the pearls. Bubble tea has grown more popular in the last ten years, and today, there are hundreds of thousands of bubble tea stores around the world!
